_doc: The Snuffer's 384-unit frames: 2 units = 1 world px, facing right, anchor (feet) at (192, 368). head = the face (his hit target); bell_mouth = the snuffer bell's mouth; slam_centre = where the slam lands; cone_tip = the lunge's leading point. World offset = (point - anchor) / 2.

_lunge_box.how: snuffer_lunge is drawn hovering 6 px off the floor (HOVER); its body, cone tip to hem, fills this box. In snuffer_boss.gd body_rect() for "lunge" and "lunge_draw": Rect2(position.x - 50, floor_y - 80, 100, 52) (symmetric about the anchor, so it holds for either facing). The bell and smoke trailing behind it are harmless.
